buildCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then node scripts/migrate.mjs; fi && next build
ignoreCommand: { if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "main" ]; then base="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; else base=main; fi; [ -n "$base" ] && [ "$base" != "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" ] && git fetch --depth=1 "https://github.com/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG.git" "$base" && git diff --quiet FETCH_HEAD HEAD -- . ':!docs/' ':!AGENTS.md' ':!CLAUDE.md' ; } || exit 1
